text:
Sasha: Heads up — after the last merge we're seeing a steady p95 decode climb in canary. Noticed KV churn and lots of kernel retries in the trace. :eyes:
Liam: saw that too, started a perf-run on the canary cluster. p95 up ~220ms -> 420ms on 512-token requests.
Kai: raw numbers?
Liam: perf-bot posted the run: https://perf.redwood/ci/2026/1777777 (summary: -18% tokens/sec, p95 up, tail allocations +30%)
perf-bot: CI perf summary: commit abc123 (PR #4321) regression detected. Top stack: attention_kernel_selector -> retry-path -> generic_attention_fallback.
Marta: interesting — PR #4321 changed the kernel probe to add a soft-retry when prefetch fails. Could be thrashing the KV prefetch path.
Sasha: I grabbed a flamegraph. Looks like repeated kernel selection + small memcpy loops when seq len toggles. Posting snippet:
```
selection_loop() {
  probe_kernel();
  if (!prefetch_ok) { retry_backoff(); goto probe; }
}
// observed replay: probe -> prefetch fail -> retry -> fallback to generic attention
```
Liam: repro command I ran locally: `./tools/perf_repro --model gpt-like --seq 512 --pattern short+long` — you can see the selector flip-flopping if you enable `--trace-kernel-selector`.
Kai: can we bisect to the exact commit in #4321? I suspect the backoff logic change.
Marta: bisect started. If we land on the selector change, we should consider short-term revert or tighten the retry threshold.
Sasha: bisect results: points to merge commit abc123 (the kernel probe ordering). Reverting that commit locally makes p95 return to baseline.
Liam: opened PR #4330 to revert the probe reorder and added a unit test for the prefetch success path.
perf-bot: canary run for PR #4330 queued.
deploy-bot: Canaries on cluster us-west-2: hold — awaiting perf results.
Kai: quick hotfix idea: instead of full revert, clamp retry attempts to 1 and add a 1ms jitter. That should stop thrash but keep probe benefits. Could ship faster.
Marta: agree. Let's land the clamp as a patch if CI for the revert takes too long.
Sasha: added a short repro snippet to the PR description and the flamegraphs. Also captured KV stats: eviction spikes line up with p95 spike — excessive prefetch + evictions.
Liam: recording the minimal failing scenario so QA can stress test: alternating seq lengths 64/512 at QPS 200 for 5m.
perf-bot: PR #4330 canary complete — perf delta back to -1% tokens/sec, p95 within noise.
deploy-bot: Revert PR #4330 merged to canary; rolling to prod paused until tomorrow morning for extended monitoring.
Kai: follow-up tasks: 1) add selector telemetry (per-model counts), 2) add KV prefetch failure metric, 3) evaluate jitter/backoff defaults.
Marta: filing the follow-up tickets and assigning. Also will add a stress test to e2e perf suite that alternates short/long sequences.
Sasha: thanks everyone. For now we keep canary rolled forward with revert; will reintroduce probe once we have better guardrails. :thumbsup:
Liam: FYI — saved traces at s3://redwood-logs/perf/1777777000-trace.tar.gz if someone wants to dig in.
Kai: looks good. Keep an eye on KV eviction percent for the next 24h.
Sasha: closing the thread for now, will reopen if we see regressions. :white_check_mark:
